name: agent-usage-tracker
title: Agent Usage
description: Rate limits and spend of the coding agents you actually use: Claude Code, Codex, OpenRouter and xAI.
author: lbug

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Agent Usage
commands.subtitle: Agent Usage
commands.description: Claude Code and Codex rate limits with reset times, OpenRouter spend today, this week and this month.

preferences.name: claudeConfigDirs
preferences.title: Additional Claude config dirs
preferences.description: Comma-separated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR paths of further Claude accounts, e.g. ~/.claude-work. ~/.claude is always included.

preferences.name: openrouterApiKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter API key
preferences.description: Optional. By default the key OpenCode uses is read from its database, then OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

preferences.name: openrouterManagementKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter management key
preferences.description: Optional. Adds spend across all your API keys, not just the one OpenCode uses.

preferences.name: xaiManagementKey
preferences.title: xAI management key
preferences.description: Optional. Shows your xAI (Grok) prepaid API balance. Create one in the xAI Console under Settings → Management Keys.

preferences.name: xaiTeamId
preferences.title: xAI team ID
preferences.description: Optional. Looked up from the management key; only needed if that fails.
